rappel_detail.anchor: rock horn, typically backed by old slings (inspect before trusting)
rappel_detail.station: Just above the steep ice north of the Rabbit Ears, on the way up the ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: The route’s one rappel, a single 30 m strand into the ‘doorway gap’ notch in the summit rib. It is on the ascent: the standard descent down the Sitkum Glacier has no rappels. Some parties simul-climb this step on screws or pickets instead.

set.rappels: One rappel on the ridge itself (a 30 m single strand into the doorway gap near the Rabbit Ears); the standard Sitkum Glacier descent has none
